remarks: Don't miss this single family home steps from downtown shops, restaurants, train & parks. With soaring ceilings, loads of sunlight & open spaces, this home offers generously sized rooms, 2 fireplaces & space for all. Enter the double heigh entry foyer to a formal living room with fireplace & a formal dining room behind. The gourmet eat in kitchen with island & high end appliances opens to the family room with loads of storage & large sliders beckon you to the terrace behind for loads of entertaining inside & out. A beautiful office / den with customized built-ins offers a great quiet space. The large primary suite boasts a huge walk in closet, changing room with custom built-ins & spa bath with double sinks, tub & shower. A 2nd bedroom offers an en suite bath. The 3rd and 4th bedrooms share a generously designed jack / jill bath. The third floor features a rec room or gym with a large storage area hidden behind. The full basement can be finished for additional 1500 SF of space. The lovely back yard offers place for pooch & play. Enjoy tennis at Mead Park and walk to almost everything!
